candidates.title: Optional continuity envelope
candidates.premise: Players may benefit from one view distinguishing authoritative franchise state, tab-only conveniences and receipts that could not persist. The six independent storage fallbacks establish a technical basis, not demand.
evidence: public/lib/returnDigest.js writeLastVisit returns false without a writer; public/lib/firstSeasonContract.js re-derives state; public/lib/playtestReceipts.js rejects unavailable writes. A new aggregate explanation would need player comprehension evidence.
